entities.name: PMID:28685010
observations: Rat spinal cord ischemia-reperfusion study used aortic arch occlusion, not abdominal aortic occlusion; reported reduced oxidative stress and autophagic neuronal cell death with hydrogen sulfide, without inflammation-specific outcomes in the retrieved evidence.

entities.name: Indirect H2S ischemia finding
observations: The identified rat aortic-arch spinal-cord ischemia study supports oxidative-stress and neuronal-protection effects, but does not establish reduced inflammation after abdominal aortic occlusion.
